dataset: make_classification 5000x20,5 informative,5 redundant,weights 0.8/0.2; seed-specific 60/20/20 stratified split
primary_metric: mean test AP over clean, 10%, 30%, 50% MCAR
control: same HGB architecture/training half A, no calibration
candidate: KMeans(8) on specified clean-only train-half-A missing masks, per occupied cluster isotonic on heldout train-half-B predictions; nearest Hamming routing. Single occupied cluster expected from proposal as written.

hyperparameters.imputer: median fit on train half A

validation_result_summary.predeclared_falsification: falsified if mean gain flat or negative across all missingness levels; support requires >=+0.01 at 50% and within +/-0.005 at 0%

known_design_consequence: Training mask vectors are all zero because proposal specifies clean training and no missingness augmentation. Eight prototypes cannot be realized; inferred route collapses to a single global isotonic map. This is treated as invalid mechanism, with held-out run as diagnostic of the collapsed variant only.
